headline: AWS is helping vibe-coding startup Superblocks, and the implications are big
snapshot: AWS now allows vibe coding tool Superblocks to be embedded into the private clouds of AWS customers. It's another step towards decoupling apps from models. The competitive question is whether this changes the model race, enterprise integrations or customer lock-in as major AI providers battle for durable platform advantage.
